paite: Huan misiangthoute a dia thilpiak thu zaw, Galatia gam a saptuam pawlte kiang a thu ka piak bang in nou leng na hih sam un.
heading: Khristian Thilpiak

paite: Ni sagih ani masapen in michih in vualzawlna na muh bang zel un koih khawl chiat un; ka hong chiang a lakkhawm himhim a-omlouhna ding in.
Huan na hehpih thilpiak uh Jerusalem a hohpih ding in ka hong tun chiang in kuapeuh hoih na chih ua lai na piak uh ka sawl ding hi.
Huan kei va hoh kilawm ahihleh, kei toh ahoh ding uhi.
Huan Masidonia gam ka totsuah khit chiang in na kiang uah ka hong ding a; Masidonia gam ka tuansuak himhim ding hi.
heading: Mimal Ngetnate

paite: Na kiang uah bang tan hiam, phalbi sung teng houh ka taam nilouh kha diam; ka hohna ding peuh a noute'n na hon khaksawn theihna ding un.
Tua pai kawm lel a hon muh malam ka ut kei a, Toupa'n lem asakleh na kiang ua sawt sim taam ka lamen hi.
Himahleh Pentikost ni tan in Ephesa ah ka taam ding hi.
Kong lianpi, phatuampi sepna ding kei a ding in akihong ngal a; huan dou mite leng tampi a-om uh.
Huan Timothi ahong tunleh lauthawng lou a na kiang ua a-omna ding in pilvang un; ke'n ka sep bangmah in Toupa nna asem hi.
Huaiziak in kuamah in musit kei uhen; ka kiang a ahong theihna ding in khamuangtak in khakhia unla; unaute toh amah muh ka lamen hi.
I unaupa Apollos thu zaw, unaute toh na kiang ua hong ding in ka deih ngial hi, himahleh tu'n zaw hong a-ut kei a; alemtan hun chiang in ahong ding hi.
Kiveng unla, ginna ah dingkip un, kihihhang unla, hattak in om un.
heading: Thuhilhna Nanungte

paite: Na hih peuhmah uh itna a hih hi vek hen.
Unaute aw, Stephenas inkuan-pihte zaw Akhaia gam a gingta masate ahi ua, misiangthoute nna sem ding in akipia uh chih na thei uhi;
huchibang mite kiang ah leh nasep a panpih leh semgim peuhte kiang a lut ding in ka hon hanthawn hi.
Huan Stephenas, Fortunate leh Akaikas ahong tun uh ka kipak hi; noute hih louh kilang lou a ka taksapna hon huh ziak un.
Amau ka lungsim leh na lungsim uh hon hihhalh ua, hichibang mite zaw kipahpih un.
Asia gam a saptuam pawlte'n chibai hon buk uhi. Akuila, Priscilla leh a-inn ua om saptuamte'n deihsaktak in Toupa ah chibai hon buk uhi.
heading: Chibai Bukna

paite: Unau tengteng in chibai hon buk uhi. Tawp siangthou in chibai kibuk un.
Kei Paul in hiai chibai bukna keimah khut mahmah a ka gelh ahi.
Kuapeuh in Toupa Jesu Khrist a-it keileh hamsethuak in om hen. I Toupa ahong pai hi.
Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna na kiang uah om hen.
Khrist Jesu a ka itna na vek ua lak ah om hen. Amen.
